scope: Independent R3 scientific audit passed for complete six-page main and selected SI pages 1–7, 13–16 and 25–27 only. Remaining 42 SI pages remain unreviewed. Cited full references remain unreviewed. Presentation refinements pending; no measured-coordinate admission.

bibliographic_scope.title: Indium Arsenide Quantum Dot Derived Catalyst for Selective CO2 Electrochemical Reduction to Formate
bibliographic_scope.authors: Fulvio Bellato; Michele Ferri; Dongxu Zhu; Thi-Hong-Hanh Le; Abinaya Annamalai; Martina Rizzo; Irene Martin; Luca Goldoni; Rosaria Brescia; Mirko Prato; Luca De Trizio; Ilka Kriegel; Liberato Manna

scope_inventory.remaining_si: SI pages 8–12,17–24,28–56 remain outside this scoped contribution. The page7 electrochemical section continues outside the selected scope.

source_interpretation.topic: Precursor chemistry and distinct synthesis controls
source_interpretation.text: Aminoarsine is conditioned with oleylamine at 40 °C until bubbling stops, consistent with source-proposed transamination. Exact reacted molecular species is unknown. The quantified 1 mmol cyanoborohydride recipe gives pure InAs; the 0.5 mmol and 3/6 mmol comparisons are distinct incompletely specified observations. Excess reductant promotes metallic In, while NaCl is a washing-dependent by-product.

evidence.locator: Supporting Information PDF p. 3,13, Sections 1.2.1–1.2.2, 2.1 and Figure S2

source_interpretation.topic: Washing comparison does not overwrite the reported recipe
source_interpretation.text: The typical recipe explicitly uses a first toluene/methanol/isopropanol wash and two later toluene/ethanol washes, each centrifuged at 4500 rpm for 10 min. Figure S2b compares ethanol versus methanol purification and reports NaCl removal using methanol. Complete alternative volumes and sequence are not supplied, so the observation is preserved separately.

evidence.locator: Supporting Information PDF p. 4,13, Workup and Figure S2b

source_interpretation.topic: Parent QDs and ligand-exchanged QDs are separate samples
source_interpretation.text: Pristine oleylamine-capped InAs has a reported 2.2 nm TEM mean and In/As ratio 1.04. After exchange, the source reports retained phase, morphology and absorption, decreased interparticle distance, loss of N 1s, S 2p near 163 eV and In/As 1.13. It does not report a newly measured 2.2 nm mean for the exchanged sample.

evidence.locator: Supporting Information PDF p. 14–15,26–27, Figures S3 and S12

source_interpretation.topic: Surface chemistry is not bulk phase purity
source_interpretation.text: Pristine XRD is consistent with zinc-blende InAs, while XPS shows about 3 at% surface oxygen and a weak As(III)-consistent contribution. A phase-pure diffraction pattern does not establish an oxygen-free surface. The ICSD patterns are references, not refined specimen atomic coordinates.

evidence.locator: Supporting Information PDF p. 14–15, Section 2.2 and Figure S3

source_interpretation.topic: Electrode fabrication and flooding are source-specific contexts
source_interpretation.text: Native oleylamine-capped QDs are deposited from toluene with a later Nafion layer for H-cell tests. Exchanged QDs are deposited from ethanol with a mixed binder ink for flow-cell tests. Source observations associate residual oleylamine with loss of support hydrophobicity; the mechanism is proposed, and no contact angle is measured or inferred from the droplet photograph.

evidence.locator: Supporting Information PDF p. 5–6,25–26, Electrode crafting and Figure S11

source_interpretation.topic: Catalytic metrics belong to the electrode and testing regime
source_interpretation.text: Near-unity formate Faradaic efficiency is the flow-cell result for exchanged-QD electrodes in 1 M KOH. The native-ligand H-cell in 1 M KHCO3 peaks near 55% at −5 mA/cm2. These are not properties of an isolated pristine particle or claims of complete electrochemical parameter coverage. Main-figure captions retain one-hour chronopotentiometry and their controls.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 2–4, Figures 1–3 and catalytic discussion

source_interpretation.topic: Reconstruction and active phase are distinct kinds of evidence
source_interpretation.text: Post-electrolysis STEM/EDS indicates In-rich agglomerates and partially oxidized InAs1−x; ex-situ XPS is In-rich and As-depleted with predominantly In2O3. Metallic indium as the operative active phase is the authors’ interpretation of electrochemistry, not the same claim as the ex-situ oxide signal. Detailed SI post-electrolysis specimen comparisons are outside the selected pages.

chemistry_context.transamination: Source proposes successive replacement of dimethylamino ligands by oleylamino groups with dimethylamine evolution. The isolated/solution molecular speciation is not measured.
chemistry_context.main_comparator_reductants: Lithium triethylborohydride and alane N,N-dimethylethylamine are prior-work comparators, not reagents of this recipe.
chemistry_context.side_products: Metallic indium under excess reducing agent; NaCl washing by-product. No quantitative phase fraction derived.

evidence.locator: Supporting Information PDF p. 3,13, Transamination equations and reductant/washing comparisons

characterization_methods.colloid_XRD: PANalytical Empyrean, 1.8 kW Cu Kα ceramic tube/PIXcel3D2×2,45kV40mA. Concentrated dispersion drop-cast on zero-diffraction single-crystal substrate; ambient room temperature; HighScore4.1.
characterization_methods.colloid_TEM: Carbon-coated Cu grids; JEOL JEM-1011 W-filament,100kV.
characterization_methods.ICP_OES: HCl/HNO3 3:1 V/V digestion, Thermofisher iCAP7600DUO. Electrode sample chopped and shaken overnight before filtration/analysis. No acid volumes supplied.
characterization_methods.optical: Varian Cary5000 UV–vis–NIR; inert sample diluted in1mL toluene,1cm quartz cuvette. Edinburgh FLS900 Xe-lamp PL; no exact PL peak digitized.
characterization_methods.XPS: Kratos Axis UltraDLD,Al Kα20kV15mA. Colloid drop-cast fewµL onto HOPG ZYB; wide scan160eVpass/1eVstep/300×700µm2; high resolution10eVpass/0.1eVstep; CasaXPS2.3.25. Electrode measured directly.
characterization_methods.electrode_SEM_EDS: Zeiss GeminiSEM560 and Oxford X-Max80mm2 SDD; maps integrate InL and AsK.
characterization_methods.electrode_STEM_EDS: Fragments sonicated in ethanol and supernatant on carbon-coatedCu; aberration-corrected JEM2200FS200kV/BrukerXFlash5060; InL,AsK,OK.

evidence.locator: Supporting Information PDF p. 4–7, Sections 1.2.4 and1.3.1

electrochemical_scope.H_cell: 25mL/chamber capacity,10mL of1MKHCO3 per chamber;1cm2 working area,Pt wire counter,eDAQ Ag/AgCl3MKCl reference,Nafion117 separator;Ivium CompactStat-e. Chelex100 electrolyte treatment is mentioned on p7, but its continuing parameters are outside this selected scope.
electrochemical_scope.Figure1: Representative50mV/s CV,E_step10mV;scan-rate series10/25/50/100/200/300mV/s and regression. Regression-derived InAs reduction potential near−0.240VvsRHE; no full parameter-table transcription.
electrochemical_scope.Figure2: H-cell1MKHCO3;LSV2mV/s,E_step1mV;one-hour CP at−5,−10,−15,−20,−25mA/cm2. Controls: noCO2,noInAs,bareSigracet,Pt; no formate assigned to those controls.
electrochemical_scope.Figure3: Flow cell1MKOH,pH14;ca1h CP. Ar control−50 andCO2−50/−100/−150mA/cm2. Right axis mean registered potential; no points digitized.
electrochemical_scope.performance_model: Main p.4 prints TOF ca.1.1×10^7 mol_In0 h^-1 with no inverse exponent on mol_In0. Dimensional/denominator interpretation is unresolved; the detailed active-site/model derivation lies in unreviewed SI, and no independent recalculation or inferred unit repair is made.
electrochemical_scope.electrode_pristine_XRD: SI16 states InAs diffraction cannot be detected at the low electrode loading; graphite/PTFE support dominates. Figure S4 is not proof of crystalline InAs in that particular electrode.
electrochemical_scope.blank_preparation: SI6 follows electrode procedures with InAs-free toluene or ethanol and Nafion; not separate nanocrystal synthesis.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 2–4, Figures1–3 and results

hydrophobicity_controls.outcome: First four retain droplets/hydrophobicity; native-QD-related and oleylamine treatment lose hydrophobicity. A single drop of pure oleylamine followed by air drying produces rapid electrolyte penetration. No angles or absolute drop volumes reported.
hydrophobicity_controls.interpretation: Authors suspect excess/free oleylamine fills pores and assists water penetration; mechanism requires further investigation.

evidence.locator: Supporting Information PDF p. 25–26, Figure S11 and discussion

entries.source_typography_note: Source prints volume B; no silent bibliographic correction.

references.si_bibliography: Not completely reviewed; selected SI references remain source citations without expansion.

limitations: Complete six-page main and explicitly selected SI pages 1–7, 13–16 and 25–27. Detailed electrochemical parameter tables and SI sections outside that page set remain unenriched; cited full sources unreviewed.

Pristine oleylamine-capped InAs, ligand-exchanged InAs, supported electrodes and post-electrolysis reconstruction are distinct specimen stages. The 2.2 nm TEM mean is assigned only to pristine QDs; no numeric size is remeasured after exchange.
The source gives flask volume, atmospheres and heating times but not vacuum pressure, injection rate, ramp, actual room temperature, cooling time or stirring rate.

Synthesis washing solvent volumes and mixing ratios, final dispersion volume and isolated yield are not given. Methanol purification comparison does not overwrite the explicitly reported first mixed-solvent wash and two later ethanol washes.
Reducing-agent and wash comparisons retain their stated variable; their complete specimen-specific schedule and quantitative phase fractions are unresolved.

Pristine and ligand-exchanged electrode recipes retain stated support dimensions and Nafion ratios. Drop-cast ink volumes and complete electrochemical tables are outside or unresolved within this declared extraction scope.
Reference ICSD structures and electrochemical active-phase interpretation are not measured particle atomic coordinates. No geometric molecular, surface or unit-cell model is asserted.
Independent source comparison passed within the declared main and selected-SI scope; molecular/particle/reference-cell presentation remains pending.
